question: How does awareness manifest inner multiplicity as outer appearance?
premises: Awareness is of the nature of awareness itself.
Many forms are situated within it.
It makes these inner forms shine outward, as in the case of a grape as universal and particular.
inference: Outer multiplicity is the outward shining of forms already present within awareness.
plain_english: For awareness, being of the nature of awareness, makes the many forms situated within it shine outward, as in the case of a grape appearing as both universal and particular.
